title: Independent V5 study of tensile supershear fracture
objective: Use the pinned public Science 2023 observations and AgentFEM's finite-strain cohesive Explicit route to determine which crack-speed, Mach-cone, wave-speed, displacement/strain, and SED/KED observations can be reproduced without unpublished author inputs.
claim_boundary: This task may establish agreement, disagreement, sensitivity, or an identified model gap. It must not infer unpublished parameters from a held-out prediction condition or describe the V4 mechanism benchmark as publication validation.

data.download: Use the official Dryad landing page; do not bypass bot protection. Run the manifest audit before interpreting a workbook.

work_packages.name: Data dictionary and units
tasks: Audit every downloaded file against size and SHA-256.
Inspect every sheet and reconstruct variable names, units, coordinate conventions, normalization, and uncertainty from README and article context.
Write one immutable tidy-data conversion with tests; retain source workbook, sheet, cell range, and conversion metadata.

work_packages.name: Calibration and prediction split
tasks: Before fitting, reserve at least one gel or weak-layer family and one SED/KED speed map as untouched prediction evidence.
Fit only independently measurable bulk response, density/wave speed, and fracture-energy information first.
Record every inferred cohesive parameter with bounds, identifiability evidence, and the observations it consumed.

work_packages.name: Numerical convergence and observer sensitivity
tasks: Run at least three spatial resolutions and two time-step safety factors with constant physical crack-speed fit length.
Resolve the cohesive length by multiple interface facets and report the ratio explicitly.
Use damage 0.50/0.75/0.95 plus opening or dissipation fronts; report speed spread instead of selecting the most favorable threshold.
Check energy balance, artificial damping, boundary reflections, preload transfer, and thin-sheet assumption before experimental comparison.

work_packages.name: Public-observation comparison
tasks: Compare v/c_s histories and critical-prestrain trends with overlap, NRMSE, and visual residuals.
Compare measured and predicted Mach-cone angle using the same wave-speed convention.
Compare SED and KED maps on a declared common physical grid without using extrapolated pixels.
Compare uy/Eyy fields and radial strain profiles when their coordinate convention is unambiguous.
Evaluate the reserved gel/weak-layer and field-map conditions only after freezing parameters.

work_packages.name: Model discrepancy and feedback
tasks: Classify disagreement as data interpretation, parameter identifiability, discretization, constitutive law, cohesive law, two-dimensional reduction, loading/boundary condition, or software defect.
For every suspected software defect, provide a minimal reproducer, expected invariant, observed result, and affected version/commit.
Propose software changes only when they are reusable beyond this publication case.

required_figures: v/c_s versus time or position with observer band
SED and KED observed/simulated/residual panels on common limits
stop_conditions: Stop a publication-level claim if units or coordinate meanings remain ambiguous.
Stop parameter fitting if the intended prediction condition has already been consumed.
Stop supershear interpretation if energy error, observer spread, or mesh sensitivity does not converge.
Report insufficient public information rather than silently inventing the JMPS input deck.
